featuredPapers.title: REVEAL: Robust Evolution of Vision-Language Models for Explainable AI-Video Detection
featuredPapers.authors: Yun-Yun Tsai, Qingyuan Liu, Ruijian Zha
featuredPapers.summary:
The rapid advancement of AI-generated video poses challenges to digital authenticity and security. 人工智能生成的视频的快速发展对数字真实性和安全性构成了挑战。
Current detection methods, often trained on specific datasets, struggle with the ever-evolving landscape of generative techniques and unseen manipulations. 当前的检测方法通常在特定数据集上进行培训，难以应对不断发展的生成技术和看不见的操作。
We introduce a framework leveraging Vision Language Models (VLMs) for robust AI-generated video detection. 我们引入了一个利用视觉语言模型（ VLM ）的框架，用于强大的人工智能生成的视频检测。
Our approach equips the VLM with the ability to reason about video content and use external tools to identify subtle inconsistencies, mirroring human system 2 thinking. 我们的方法使VLM能够对视频内容进行推理，并使用外部工具来识别微妙的不一致性，从而反映人类系统2的思维。
Our self-evolving VLM dynamically selects and composes appropriate tools, enhancing its ability to generalize to novel video generation techniques. 我们的自我进化VLM动态选择和组合适当的工具，增强其推广到新颖视频生成技术的能力。
The modular design promotes interpretability, allowing for a clearer understanding of VLM's decision-making process. 模块化设计提高了可解释性，从而更清楚地了解VLM的决策过程。
To evaluate, we establish the first benchmark VidForensic containing 1.4k+ high-quality AI-generated videos across eight generative models. 为了进行评估，我们在八个生成模型中建立了第一个包含1.4k+高质量AI生成视频的基准VidForensic。
Experiments show that REVEAL improves F1 scores by 9.1% to 30.2% over top baselines across our datasets for VLMs, notably for GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 pro, and QWen-VL-Max, and Llava-One-Vision-7B. 实验表明，在我们的VLM数据集中， REVEL将F1分数比最高基线提高了9.1%至30.2% ，尤其是GPT-4o、Gemini 1.5 pro和QWen-VL-Max以及Llava-One-Vision-7B。
While open-world AI-video detection remains an open challenge, our results indicate that existing methods fail primarily because they lack tool-enabled, higher-order reasoning. 虽然开放世界的人工智能视频检测仍然是一个公开的挑战，但我们的结果表明，现有方法之所以失败，主要是因为它们缺乏工具支持的高阶推理。
highlights: introduce a framework leveraging Vision Language Model
The rapid advancement of AI-generated video poses challenges to digital authenticity and security.

featuredPapers.title: SHARPO: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
featuredPapers.authors: Xinchen Du, Zhengze Zhou, Wenhui Zhu
featuredPapers.summary:
Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) trains a large language model (LLM) to act over long, multi-step interactions. Agentic强化学习（ RL ）训练大型语言模型（ LLM ） ，以应对长时间、多步骤的交互。
However, a single localized error can cause task failure, while trajectory-level rewards provide limited guidance for assigning credit to individual decisions. 然而，单个局部错误可能导致任务失败，而轨迹级奖励为个人决策分配信用提供有限的指导。
To address this limitation, we introduce Segment-level Hindsight Advantage Reweighting for Policy Optimization (SHARPO), a credit-assignment mechanism that refines Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) at the level of environment-facing segments. 为了解决这一限制，我们引入了针对政策优化的细分级事后优势重新加权（ SHARPO ） ，这是一种信用分配机制，在面向环境的细分级层面完善了集团相对政策优化（ GRPO ）。
Inspired by the existing on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) method, SHARPO computes teacher-student log-probability gaps within each segment and uses the resulting signal to compute a bounded multiplier on the GRPO advantage. 受现有政策自馏（ OPSD ）方法的启发， SHARPO计算每个细分市场中的师生对数概率差距，并使用所得信号计算GRPO优势的有界乘数。
This multiplier is shared by all tokens within the segment, allowing credit to vary across different segments. 此乘数由细分市场内的所有代币共享，允许不同细分市场之间的信用额度有所不同。
With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, SHARPO outperforms existing baselines on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks, including GRPO, SDAR, RLSD, and StepOPSD. 使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ， SHARPO的表现优于ALFWorld和WebShop基准的现有基线，包括GRPO、SDAR、RLSD和StepOPSD。
highlights: outperforms existing baselines on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks

featuredPapers.title: GUI-HARVEST: Self-Improving GUI Agents through Evidence-Driven Harness Evolution
featuredPapers.authors: Geyi Yang, Zikun Qu, Xiang Li
featuredPapers.summary:
The executable harness surrounding a GUI model determines how observations are assembled, actions are executed, and verification, recovery, and termination are controlled. 围绕GUI模型的可执行线束决定了如何组装观察、执行操作以及控制验证、恢复和终止。
Compared with harness optimization for non-GUI agents, automatically optimizing this harness poses three coupled challenges: reconciling model intent with observed visual effects, diagnosing failures under variable execution outcomes, and identifying recurrent failure patterns across tasks and translating them into reusable runtime changes. 与非GUI代理的线束优化相比，自动优化此线束带来了三个耦合的挑战：协调模型意图与观察到的视觉效果，诊断可变执行结果下的故障，以及识别跨任务的复发故障模式并将其转换为可重用的运行时更改。
We introduce GUI-HARVEST, an automatic harness optimizer that enables self-improving GUI agents with frozen backbone models. 我们引入了GUI-HARVEST ，这是一种自动线束优化器，可使用冻结的骨干模型自我改进GUI代理。
First, to ground diagnosis in observed action effects, it aligns model outputs and executed actions with before-and-after screenshots, tying findings to specific interface transitions. 首先，为了在观察到的动作效果中进行地面诊断，它将模型输出和执行动作与之前和之后的屏幕截图对齐，将发现与特定的界面转换联系起来。
Second, to account for execution variability, it treats repeated runs of the same task as a joint evidence unit, using within-task comparisons to locate outcome-relevant behavioral differences. 其次，为了考虑执行变异性，它将同一任务的重复运行视为联合证据单元，使用任务内比较来定位与结果相关的行为差异。
Third, it consolidates verified findings across tasks into recurring failure patterns, maps them to bounded source-code edits with predictions recorded before evaluation, and checks the predicted behavioral effects alongside task performance through repeated execution. 第三，它将跨任务的验证结果整合到重复的失败模式中，将其映射到有界的源代码编辑，并在评估之前记录预测，并通过重复执行来检查预测的行为效果和任务性能。
Experiments on OSWorld-Verified show consistent held-out gains across six general-purpose open, GUI-specialized open, and proprietary backbone models; Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct gains 12.33 points on the full suite. OSWorld-Verified的实验表明，六种通用开放式、GUI专用开放式和专有骨干模型获得了一致的增益； Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct在全套产品上获得了12.33分。
Frozen-harness transfer improves GPT-5 by 13.87 percentage points on WindowsAgentArena at 50 steps without further optimization. Frozen-harness transfer使WindowsAgentArena上的GPT-5在50步时提高了13.87个百分点，而无需进一步优化。
With the same backbone and initial harness, GUI-HARVEST outperforms Self-Harness and Meta-Harness, suggesting that GUI-specific diagnosis and validation help harness improvements generalize to unseen tasks. 使用相同的主干和初始线束， GUI-HARVEST的性能优于Self-Harness和Meta-Harness ，这表明GUI特定的诊断和验证有助于利用改进推广到看不见的任务。
The code is available at https://github.com/GaryYang12345/GUI-HARVEST. 该代码可在https://github.com/GaryYang12345/GUI-HARVEST上获得。

featuredPapers.authors: Yusuf Afifi, Artur Kiulian, Anton Polishko

featuredPapers.title: Detecting Multi-Agent Collusion Through Multi-Agent Interpretability
featuredPapers.authors: Aaron Rose, Carissa Cullen, Sahar Abdelnabi
featuredPapers.summary:
As LLM agents are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems, they introduce risks of covert coordination that may evade standard forms of human oversight. 随着LLM代理越来越多地部署在多代理系统中，它们引入了可能逃避标准形式的人类监督的秘密协调风险。
While linear probes on model activations have shown promise for detecting deception in single-agent settings, collusion is inherently a multi-agent phenomenon, and the use of internal representations for detecting collusion between agents remains unexplored. 虽然模型激活的线性探针已显示出在单代理设置中检测欺骗的前景，但勾结本质上是一种多代理现象，并且使用内部表示来检测代理之间的勾结仍未得到探索。
We introduce NARCBench, a benchmark for evaluating collusion detection under environment distribution shift, and propose five probing techniques that aggregate per-agent deception scores to classify scenarios at the group level, evaluated across four open-weight models (Qwen3-32B, Llama-3.1-70B, DeepSeek-R1 32B, GPT-OSS-20B) and six probe architectures. 我们引入了NARCBench ，这是评估环境分布变化下的勾结检测的基准，并提出了五种探测技术，汇总每个代理的欺骗分数，以便在组级别对场景进行分类，这些技术在四个开放权重模型（ Qwen3-32B ， Llama-3.1-70B ， DeepSeek-R1 32B ， GPT-OSS-20B ）和六个探测架构中进行了评估。
We frame this as a distributed anomaly detection problem, identifying three collusion signatures that map onto distinct anomaly types and detection paradigms. 我们将其视为分布式异常检测问题，识别映射到不同异常类型和检测范式的三个勾结特征。
Every model reaches 1.00 AUROC in-distribution; on our strongest model (Llama-3.1-70B), our five probing techniques achieve 0.73 to 0.93 AUROC when transferred zero-shot to structurally different multi-agent scenarios and 0.99 to 1.00 on a steganographic blackjack card-counting task, with detection performance scaling with model capability. 每个模型都达到1.00 AUROC分布；在我们最强的模型（ Llama-3.1-70B ）上，我们的五种探测技术在将零点转移到结构不同的多代理场景时实现0.73至0.93 AUROC ，在隐写二十一点卡片计数任务中实现0.99至1.00 ，并具有模型功能的检测性能缩放。
We find that no single probing technique dominates across all collusion types, consistent with the framework's prediction that different anomaly types require different detection paradigms. 我们发现，没有单一的探测技术在所有勾结类型中占主导地位，这与框架的预测一致，即不同的异常类型需要不同的检测范式。
This work takes a step toward multi-agent interpretability: extending white-box inspection from single models to multi-agent contexts, where detection requires aggregating signals across agents. 这项工作朝着多Agent可解释性迈出了一步：将白盒检查从单个模型扩展到多Agent上下文，其中检测需要跨Agent聚合信号。
These results suggest that model internals provide a complementary signal to text-level monitoring for detecting multi-agent collusion. 这些结果表明，模型内部为文本级监控提供了补充信号，用于检测多智能体勾结。
Code and data available at https://github.com/aaronrose227/narcbench. 代码和数据可在https://github.com/aaronrose227/narcbench上获得。

featuredPapers.title: Kernel-Managed Shared Memory for System-Wide Personalization
featuredPapers.authors: Ryan Lum, Yongfeng Zhang
featuredPapers.summary:
AI systems become more useful when they can adapt to the people using them, but in multi-agent systems, useful context learned by one agent often remains unavailable to others. 当人工智能系统能够适应使用它们的人时，它们会变得更有用，但在多智能体系统中，一个智能体学习的有用上下文通常对其他人不可用。
We present kernel-managed shared memory, a system-level abstraction in which specialized agents write structured, tagged memories while the agent-system kernel, not individual agents, governs retrieval, privacy enforcement, and prompt injection. 我们提出了内核管理的共享内存，这是一种系统级抽象，其中专业代理编写结构化的标记内存，而代理系统内核而不是单个代理管理检索、隐私强制和提示注入。
We implement and evaluate this design on AIOS and compare it against three alternatives across three assistant models (GPT-4o, Llama-3.1:8B, Qwen-2.5:7B) and 1,800 total trials. 我们在AIOS上实施和评估此设计，并将其与三个辅助模型（ GPT-4o ， Llama-3.1 ： 8B ， Qwen-2.5 ： 7B ）和1,800个总试验的三种替代方案进行比较。
Against an unmanaged external memory backend (Mem0) using identical underlying storage, kernel-managed retrieval and injection improve personalization scores by 2.4-4.0 points on a 5-point scale (e.g., 1.05 to 4.69 profile usage on GPT-4o), with every comparison significant at p < 10^-18. 针对使用相同底层存储的非托管外部内存后端（ Mem0 ） ，内核托管检索和注入在5分制下将个性化分数提高了2.4-4.0分（例如， GPT-4o上的配置文件使用率为1.05至4.69 ） ，每次比较在p < 10 ^ -18时都具有显著性。
Against standard retrieval-augmented injection, gains are similarly large and consistent across all three models. 与标准的检索增强注射相比，在所有三个模型中，增益都同样大且一致。
Against full, unfiltered context concatenation, a soft ceiling on available context rather than on response quality, kernel-managed injection statistically matches performance on two of three models and shows a small, model-specific deficit on the third, while using substantially shorter prompts: end-to-end latency is 15-61% lower across all three models, with corresponding reductions in per-call token usage and inference cost. 针对完整的未过滤上下文级联，可用上下文而不是响应质量的软上限，内核管理的注入在统计上匹配三个模型中的两个模型的性能，并在第三个模型上显示出小的模型特定缺陷，同时使用大大缩短的提示：在所有三个模型中，端到端延迟降低了15-61% ，相应地减少了每次调用的令牌使用量和推断成本。
These results indicate that centralizing memory management in the agent-system kernel, rather than leaving retrieval and privacy enforcement to individual agents, delivers most of the personalization benefit of unconstrained context at a fraction of its cost. 这些结果表明，将内存管理集中在代理系统内核中，而不是将检索和隐私实施留给单个代理，可以以其成本的一小部分提供无约束上下文的大部分个性化优势。
highlights: Against standard retrieval-augmented injection, gains are similarly large and consistent across all three models.

featuredPapers.title: iARCS: Iterative Agentic RL for Controllable 3D Scene Generation
featuredPapers.authors: Saugat Adhikari, Ashok Prasad Neupane, Pramish Paudel
featuredPapers.summary:
Synthetic 3D scene generation is increasingly used as a data source for computer vision and embodied AI, but existing generators often optimize perceptual realism without reliably satisfying task-critical functional constraints. 合成3D场景生成越来越多地用作计算机视觉和具体化AI的数据源，但现有生成器通常优化感知真实感，而不可靠地满足任务关键型功能约束。
This mismatch limits the usefulness of synthetic data for downstream training, where accessibility, traversability, and spatial rule compliance are often essential. 这种不匹配限制了合成数据在下游培训中的实用性，而可访问性、可遍历性和空间规则合规性往往是必不可少的。
We present iARCS, an iterative agentic reinforcement learning framework that adapts a pretrained scene generator to naturallanguage task requirements. 我们提出了iARCS ，这是一个迭代代理强化学习框架，它使预训练的场景生成器适应自然语言任务要求。
iARCS uses a two-phase strategy: universal-reward pretraining to improve physical plausibility and layout quality, followed by task-specific finetuning with LLM-generated reward programs that are iteratively refined from training feedback. iARCS使用两阶段策略：通用奖励预训练以提高物理合理性和布局质量，然后使用LLM生成的奖励计划进行特定任务的微调，这些奖励计划是从训练反馈中迭代改进的。
Experiments show improved constraint fidelity on walkability, reachability, and clearance-focused tasks, effective task-specific constraint optimization, and competitive scene diversity. 实验表明，在可步行性、可达性和以间隙为中心的任务上提高了约束保真度，有效的特定任务约束优化以及竞争场景多样性。
We further show that data generated by iARCS improves a base generator, supporting its value as a practical synthetic data generation tool rather than only a controllable scene editing method. 我们进一步表明， iARCS生成的数据改进了基本生成器，支持其作为实用合成数据生成工具的价值，而不仅仅是可控场景编辑方法。

featuredPapers.title: Verbal tics in frontier language models: A critical review of current releases, research evidence, and public discussion
featuredPapers.authors: Shuai Wu, Xue Li, Zhijun Wang
featuredPapers.summary:
Repeated praise, canned reassurance, familiar contrasts, and conspicuous vocabulary are recurring subjects in discussions of large language models. 在大型语言模型的讨论中，反复的赞美、罐装的保证、熟悉的对比和引人注目的词汇是反复出现的主题。
Their interpretation depends on context: a conventional phrase may be useful, while a fluent answer may reinforce a false belief. 他们的解释取决于上下文：传统的短语可能有用，而流利的答案可能会强化错误的信念。
This critical review examines linguistic habits and sycophancy across eight developer families: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI, ByteDance, Moonshot AI, DeepSeek, and Xiaomi. 这篇重要评论考察了八个开发者家族的语言习惯和嗜好： OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind、xAI、ByteDance、Moonshot AI、DeepSeek和小米。
We verify current public offerings against official release and API documentation, with an evidence cutoff of 1 October 2026. 我们根据官方发布和API文档验证当前的公开募股，证据截止日期为2026年10月1日。
We synthesize research on lexical overrepresentation, stylistic variation, social warmth, and agreement, alongside benchmark methods and dated English and Chinese public discussions. 我们综合了有关词汇过度表达、风格变化、社会温暖和协议的研究，以及基准方法和过时的英文和中文公开讨论。

featuredPapers.title: False Prophets: On the Security of World Models in Agentic Systems
featuredPapers.authors: Erik Imgrund, Anna Wimbauer, Klim Kireev
featuredPapers.summary:

featuredPapers.title: Global Coherence: When Every Agent Is Right and the Team Is Still Wrong - A Local-to-Global Semantic Foundation for Multi-Agent Collaboration
featuredPapers.authors: Xin Heng
featuredPapers.summary:
AI agents can each make locally valid decisions yet jointly produce an invalid result.
We call this the global coherence problem: a failure of shared state, not merely of model intelligence.
Our Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem gives the exact boundary.
A policy can guarantee a valid action exactly when all worlds producing the same observation share an admissible action.
If k indistinguishable worlds require pairwise-disjoint actions, the best randomized worst-case success is 1/k; more reasoning, roles, messages, or samples cannot recover the missing distinction.
A stronger model can reason better within its context, but it cannot see beyond it.
We then give local-to-global runtime semantics X = (H, C, G, F; D): topology H records overlapping scopes; category C governs state-changing actions; groupoid G retains reversible translations; sheaf F tests whether local views glue into one world; and minimal history D keeps only distinctions that alter legal futures.
Models propose; the harness owns shared state and governs commit.
Nine studies test both the failure and its boundary.
On a controlled revision benchmark, the same frontier model scores 40/40 when the deciding event is visible; when it is hidden, tested arms score 12--17/40, consistent with chance (1/3); restoring one authoritative fact returns 40/40.
On TeamBench, ordinary teams exceed a shared budget in 5/5 runs, a visible live count leaves 4/5 violations, and commit enforcement leaves 0/5.
In tau2-bench Telecom, current-state checks score 0.07 after silent reverts, while the harness scores 1.00.
Where a conventional solver already owns the complete relevant state, it ties the harness as predicted.
The counterintuitive conclusion is that local intelligence cannot substitute for missing global state.

Current detection methods, often trained on specific datasets, struggle with the ever-evolving landscape of generative techniques and unseen manipulations. 当前的检测方法通常在特定数据集上进行培训，难以应对不断发展的生成技术和看不见的操作。
We introduce a framework leveraging Vision Language Models (VLMs) for robust AI-generated video detection. 我们引入了一个利用视觉语言模型（ VLM ）的框架，用于强大的人工智能生成的视频检测。
Our approach equips the VLM with the ability to reason about video content and use external tools to identify subtle inconsistencies, mirroring human system 2 thinking. 我们的方法使VLM能够对视频内容进行推理，并使用外部工具来识别微妙的不一致性，从而反映人类系统2的思维。
Our self-evolving VLM dynamically selects and composes appropriate tools, enhancing its ability to generalize to novel video generation techniques. 我们的自我进化VLM动态选择和组合适当的工具，增强其推广到新颖视频生成技术的能力。
The modular design promotes interpretability, allowing for a clearer understanding of VLM's decision-making process. 模块化设计提高了可解释性，从而更清楚地了解VLM的决策过程。
To evaluate, we establish the first benchmark VidForensic containing 1.4k+ high-quality AI-generated videos across eight generative models. 为了进行评估，我们在八个生成模型中建立了第一个包含1.4k+高质量AI生成视频的基准VidForensic。
Experiments show that REVEAL improves F1 scores by 9.1% to 30.2% over top baselines across our datasets for VLMs, notably for GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 pro, and QWen-VL-Max, and Llava-One-Vision-7B. 实验表明，在我们的VLM数据集中， REVEL将F1分数比最高基线提高了9.1%至30.2% ，尤其是GPT-4o、Gemini 1.5 pro和QWen-VL-Max以及Llava-One-Vision-7B。
While open-world AI-video detection remains an open challenge, our results indicate that existing methods fail primarily because they lack tool-enabled, higher-order reasoning. 虽然开放世界的人工智能视频检测仍然是一个公开的挑战，但我们的结果表明，现有方法之所以失败，主要是因为它们缺乏工具支持的高阶推理。
highlights: introduce a framework leveraging Vision Language Model
The rapid advancement of AI-generated video poses challenges to digital authenticity and security.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: SHARPO: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary:
Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) trains a large language model (LLM) to act over long, multi-step interactions. Agentic强化学习（ RL ）训练大型语言模型（ LLM ） ，以应对长时间、多步骤的交互。
However, a single localized error can cause task failure, while trajectory-level rewards provide limited guidance for assigning credit to individual decisions. 然而，单个局部错误可能导致任务失败，而轨迹级奖励为个人决策分配信用提供有限的指导。
To address this limitation, we introduce Segment-level Hindsight Advantage Reweighting for Policy Optimization (SHARPO), a credit-assignment mechanism that refines Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) at the level of environment-facing segments. 为了解决这一限制，我们引入了针对政策优化的细分级事后优势重新加权（ SHARPO ） ，这是一种信用分配机制，在面向环境的细分级层面完善了集团相对政策优化（ GRPO ）。
Inspired by the existing on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) method, SHARPO computes teacher-student log-probability gaps within each segment and uses the resulting signal to compute a bounded multiplier on the GRPO advantage. 受现有政策自馏（ OPSD ）方法的启发， SHARPO计算每个细分市场中的师生对数概率差距，并使用所得信号计算GRPO优势的有界乘数。
This multiplier is shared by all tokens within the segment, allowing credit to vary across different segments. 此乘数由细分市场内的所有代币共享，允许不同细分市场之间的信用额度有所不同。
With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, SHARPO outperforms existing baselines on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks, including GRPO, SDAR, RLSD, and StepOPSD. 使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ， SHARPO的表现优于ALFWorld和WebShop基准的现有基线，包括GRPO、SDAR、RLSD和StepOPSD。
highlights: outperforms existing baselines on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: GUI-HARVEST: Self-Improving GUI Agents through Evidence-Driven Harness Evolution
papers.summary:
The executable harness surrounding a GUI model determines how observations are assembled, actions are executed, and verification, recovery, and termination are controlled. 围绕GUI模型的可执行线束决定了如何组装观察、执行操作以及控制验证、恢复和终止。
Compared with harness optimization for non-GUI agents, automatically optimizing this harness poses three coupled challenges: reconciling model intent with observed visual effects, diagnosing failures under variable execution outcomes, and identifying recurrent failure patterns across tasks and translating them into reusable runtime changes. 与非GUI代理的线束优化相比，自动优化此线束带来了三个耦合的挑战：协调模型意图与观察到的视觉效果，诊断可变执行结果下的故障，以及识别跨任务的复发故障模式并将其转换为可重用的运行时更改。
We introduce GUI-HARVEST, an automatic harness optimizer that enables self-improving GUI agents with frozen backbone models. 我们引入了GUI-HARVEST ，这是一种自动线束优化器，可使用冻结的骨干模型自我改进GUI代理。
First, to ground diagnosis in observed action effects, it aligns model outputs and executed actions with before-and-after screenshots, tying findings to specific interface transitions. 首先，为了在观察到的动作效果中进行地面诊断，它将模型输出和执行动作与之前和之后的屏幕截图对齐，将发现与特定的界面转换联系起来。
Second, to account for execution variability, it treats repeated runs of the same task as a joint evidence unit, using within-task comparisons to locate outcome-relevant behavioral differences. 其次，为了考虑执行变异性，它将同一任务的重复运行视为联合证据单元，使用任务内比较来定位与结果相关的行为差异。
Third, it consolidates verified findings across tasks into recurring failure patterns, maps them to bounded source-code edits with predictions recorded before evaluation, and checks the predicted behavioral effects alongside task performance through repeated execution. 第三，它将跨任务的验证结果整合到重复的失败模式中，将其映射到有界的源代码编辑，并在评估之前记录预测，并通过重复执行来检查预测的行为效果和任务性能。
Experiments on OSWorld-Verified show consistent held-out gains across six general-purpose open, GUI-specialized open, and proprietary backbone models; Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct gains 12.33 points on the full suite. OSWorld-Verified的实验表明，六种通用开放式、GUI专用开放式和专有骨干模型获得了一致的增益； Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct在全套产品上获得了12.33分。
Frozen-harness transfer improves GPT-5 by 13.87 percentage points on WindowsAgentArena at 50 steps without further optimization. Frozen-harness transfer使WindowsAgentArena上的GPT-5在50步时提高了13.87个百分点，而无需进一步优化。
With the same backbone and initial harness, GUI-HARVEST outperforms Self-Harness and Meta-Harness, suggesting that GUI-specific diagnosis and validation help harness improvements generalize to unseen tasks. 使用相同的主干和初始线束， GUI-HARVEST的性能优于Self-Harness和Meta-Harness ，这表明GUI特定的诊断和验证有助于利用改进推广到看不见的任务。
The code is available at https://github.com/GaryYang12345/GUI-HARVEST. 该代码可在https://github.com/GaryYang12345/GUI-HARVEST上获得。

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Do Your Own Research: Learning to Forecast by Learning to Search
papers.summary:
Outcome-based reinforcement learning can train language models to forecast real-world events, but prior forecasting work either freezes research context before training or deploys agentic research only at test time, so the skill of gathering evidence is never shaped by the reward. 基于结果的强化学习可以训练语言模型来预测现实世界的事件，但先前的预测工作要么在训练前冻结研究背景，要么仅在测试时部署代理研究，因此收集证据的技能永远不会受到奖励的影响。
We introduce an agentic forecasting environment, dataset, and harness built from 2,100+ resolved Polymarket questions; the agent acquires its own context at rollout time (web search, page reading, and financial time series, all restricted by layered leak filtering to information published before each question's cutoff), and we train Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (3B active parameters) on it with single-epoch GRPO under a Brier-score reward. 我们引入了由2,100多个已解决的Polymarket问题构建的代理预测环境、数据集和线束；代理在推出时获取自己的上下文（网页搜索、页面阅读和财务时间序列，所有这些都受分层泄漏过滤的限制，仅限于每个问题截止之前发布的信息） ，我们使用Brier分数奖励下的单时段GRPO对其进行Qwen3.5-35B-A3B （ 3B活动参数）培训。
Training changes how the agent interacts with information: calibration improves 30-40%, and search attempts fall from 3.8 to 2.25 per rollout as evidence discipline is learned. 培训改变了客服代表与信息的互动方式：校准提高了30-40% ，随着证据纪律的学习，每次推广的搜索尝试次数从3.8次减少到2.25次。
Evaluated in an identical harness against four frontier models, the trained policy also finishes ahead of every frontier model tested at evidence-based forecasting, including Claude Opus 4.5 (soft-Brier 0.254 vs. 在四个前沿模型的完全相同的线束中进行评估，训练有素的政策也在循证预测中测试的每个前沿模型之前完成，包括Claude Opus 4.5 （ soft-Brier 0.254 vs.
0.256, n=265), at about 5% of the inference cost, and its margin is widest on the hardest questions, the ones the crowd itself had not decided. 0.256 ， n = 265 ） ，约占推理成本的5 ％ ，并且在最困难的问题上，即人群本身尚未决定的问题上，其余量最大。
We release the environment, dataset, and per-rollout records as a reusable harness for temporal forecasting agents. 我们发布环境、数据集和每次发布记录，作为时间预测代理的可重用线束。
